**Known hazards for future sprints:**
- src/cli/roadmap-source-store.ts completeRoadmapSourceSprint: auto-promotion to complete must gate on an in-flight status set; the write path also hardcodes changed:true so callers cannot infer whether anything actually changed from the non-dry-run result.
- src/core/roadmap.ts isRoadmapSprintPending vs isRoadmapSprintTerminal: deferred is deliberately non-terminal but non-selectable; the two predicates are not complements.
